steps.goal: Validate landing area, nearby hazard envelope, and starter resource radius.
Collect branchwood, echomaterialcore:fieldstone pieces, fiber, and flint.
Craft crude cutter/breaker/digger using tool role contracts.
Craft early light from echomaterialcore:pitch_resin echomaterialcore:resin and branchwood stick.
Place field bench as the first shared station.
Build a minimal shelter footprint and calculate starter shelter score.
Award starter cache only after shelter and station checks pass.

experienceExtensionPoint: Experiences append step 7+ with their own fantasy goal, such as Openlands first waystone or Ashfall first sealed shelter.
